weeks.assessment: On a fresh fixture, identify where cancellation or queueing is handled and verify against code/tests. Test the result and document why it passes or fails. For block-ending weeks, include a cumulative checkpoint within the same study slot.
weeks.evidence: runnable artifact (or trace/explanation for conceptual weeks), tests or experiment output, one failure or trade-off, five-minute explanation, four-dimension score. For this week, a reproducible small educational demonstration is sufficient; do not claim production completeness.

projects.title: Flagship support and knowledge workflow
projects.purpose: A consent-based small-business support workflow, or an explicitly marked simulation. Gradually extend one codebase rather than starting a new app for each unit.
projects.functionalRequirements: A user/admin can submit and triage cases, manage knowledge sources, search answers with citations, inspect logs, approve sensitive actions, and recover from failures. Multi-tenant isolation where relevant.
projects.milestones: W1–5 service and TLS; W6–11 schema, indexing, isolation and restore; W12–16 CI/CD and observability; W17–24 auth, integrations and reliable ingestion; W33–40 retrieval, evals, safe tools and review UI; W41–47 deployment/pilot and case study.
projects.acceptanceTests: Cross-tenant access denied, duplicate webhook idempotent, backups restore cleanly, prompt injection cannot perform unauthorized actions, wrong answers can be flagged, rollback rehearsal succeeds. Record p50/p95 latency, held-out answer quality, cost/request and a clearly labeled sample size.
projects.requiredEvidence: Demo + README, architecture and threat model, migration and restore scripts, reproducible evaluation runner, consent record or simulation flag, user-visible runbook, and before/after results with limitations.
projects.exitCondition: Demonstrate the bounded milestone in its mapped week, pass the four gates, attach evidence and **manually verify**; otherwise keep the relevant week locked. Any project-wide completion claim must pass all core acceptance checks.

projects.title: Webhook reliability and replay service
projects.scope: Optional independent service; skip if flagship slips.
projects.purpose: A small standalone intake and replay service rather than a commercial webhook platform.
projects.functionalRequirements: Authenticated intake with signature verification, durable event storage, retries with bounded backoff, idempotency key handling, dead-letter state, operator-only replay and traceable audit events.
projects.milestones: W19 verify signatures and persist; W20 rate-limit; W21 queue, deduplicate and replay; W22–24 fault injection, observability and design review.
projects.acceptanceTests: Reject invalid signature, do not double-apply on duplicates, survive worker restart and replay without data loss, bound retry attempts, audit each manual replay; measure recovery time and duplicate-effect count.
projects.requiredEvidence: Minimal API contract, tested worker, fault-injection script, replay command, README, design trade-offs and benchmark logs.
projects.exitCondition: Demonstrate the bounded milestone in its mapped week, pass the four gates, attach evidence and **manually verify**; otherwise keep the relevant week locked. Any project-wide completion claim must pass all core acceptance checks.

projects.title: Educational B-tree key-value store
projects.purpose: Small persistent store to understand pages, buffer management and recovery; avoid production database claims.

projects.milestones: W54 pages; W55 B-tree; W56 buffer pool; W57 scans; W58 WAL/recovery; W59 tests and benchmarking.
projects.acceptanceTests: Property tests against an in-memory reference map; restart/persistence tests; randomized inserts; split corner cases; corruption and crash-injection tests. Compare throughput with fixed hardware and input sizes.
projects.requiredEvidence: File format design, correctness harness, crash-test logs, README and benchmark methodology.
projects.exitCondition: Demonstrate the bounded milestone in its mapped week, pass the four gates, attach evidence and **manually verify**; otherwise keep the relevant week locked. Any project-wide completion claim must pass all core acceptance checks.

projects.title: Replicated key-value store laboratory
projects.purpose: A bounded replication and Raft experiment; full fault-tolerant production consensus is out of scope.
projects.functionalRequirements: Lamport-clock simulation, primary-backup prototype, consensus traces, leader election, constrained log replication and deterministic fault tests.
projects.milestones: W60 clocks; W61 replication; W62 Paxos trace; W63 leader election; W64 log replication; W65 failure tests.
projects.acceptanceTests: Verify one leader per term in tested scenarios, no committed-entry divergence under modeled failures, correct replay following restarts, and documented known deviations from full Raft. Use deterministic schedules and assertions.
projects.requiredEvidence: Simulation harness, invariant checks, event traces, model limitations and paper-based comparison.
projects.exitCondition: Demonstrate the bounded milestone in its mapped week, pass the four gates, attach evidence and **manually verify**; otherwise keep the relevant week locked. Any project-wide completion claim must pass all core acceptance checks.
